subject.title: [Feature]: Open bot-inclusive Slack group DMs from App Home

question: Should the bundled Slack plugin ship a native App Home flow that lets a DM-authorized Slack user create or resume a bot-inclusive group DM with selected members?
rationale: The current request is plausible and aligned with Slack App Home support, but it adds user-triggered conversation creation, starter-message behavior, and group-scoped agent access that require maintainer product/security-boundary intent.

options.title: Approve bounded App Home opener after proof
options.body: Land the linked implementation only if it keeps the existing gates, documents the no-history-transfer limitation, and adds redacted live Slack create/reopen proof.

options.title: Require stricter member authorization
options.body: Ask for a revised design that checks selected members or adds an explicit opt-in policy before a creator can grant group-scoped access.

options.title: Keep docs and workarounds only
options.body: Do not add native MPIM creation now; continue pointing users to private-channel conversion or external conversations.open usage.

recommendation.title: Approve bounded App Home opener after proof
recommendation.body: Land the linked implementation only if it keeps the existing gates, documents the no-history-transfer limitation, and adds redacted live Slack create/reopen proof.

likelyOwner.reason: Vincent introduced the current Slack App Home surface and has recent history in the Slack monitor/setup files this decision affects.
